change.summary: Operators placing wood, leather, coffee, cocoa, rubber, soy or palm-oil products on the EU market must show they are deforestation-free and traceable to the plot of land. Application for small and micro enterprises from 30 June 2026 (verify: dates have shifted before).

obligations.text: Do not sell covered products unless they are deforestation-free and legally produced.
obligations.quote: Relevant commodities and relevant products shall not be placed or made available on the market or exported, unless all the following conditions are fulfilled: (a) they are deforestation-free

obligations.text: Collect geolocation of the plots of land where the commodity was produced.
obligations.quote: the geolocation of all plots of land where the relevant commodities that the relevant product contains, or has been made using, were produced

obligations.text: Keep due-diligence records for five years.
obligations.quote: Operators shall keep for at least 5 years from the date of the placing on the market or export of the relevant products all documentation related to due diligence

reasons: You sell wooden furniture and leather goods — both are covered commodities (wood, cattle/leather).
You place products on the EU market from Germany, so you are an operator or trader under the regulation.

todos.text: Ask each furniture and leather supplier for plot geolocation and origin evidence
todos.quote: the geolocation of all plots of land where the relevant commodities that the relevant product contains, or has been made using, were produced

todos.text: Set up a folder per product line to keep due-diligence documents for five years
todos.quote: Operators shall keep for at least 5 years from the date of the placing on the market or export of the relevant products all documentation related to due diligence
